business_problem: HR, payroll, finance, and business data lived in separate tools, forcing SD Worx customers to spend too much manual effort combining information before they could see workforce trends, control costs, or maintain compliance.
solution_summary: SD Worx built a unified HR analytics architecture on Snowflake running on Azure to replace disconnected payroll, finance, and business-data tools with a single source of workforce truth. Customer datasets are ingested and orchestrated with DBT, Azure data factory, and Airflow into a centralized Snowflake warehouse, where the company standardizes payroll and HCM data, joins it with weekly benchmarking datasets, and calculates daily insights such as wage-cost anomalies and absenteeism. The service is delivered in two modes: a web application with Power BI embedded dashboards for customers that want ready-made insight, and an Insights Cloud model that shares data through a private Snowflake Marketplace and direct Snowflake access for deeper self-service analysis. This design lets SD Worx serve both SMEs and large enterprises with the same governed platform while also powering a consulting practice that turns shared HR data into compliance, cost, and workforce decisions.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Hosts the centralized HR and payroll data warehouse that underpins SD Worx Insights and customer analytics.

solution_components.name: DBT
solution_components.role: Transforms unified customer data into the curated HR models and metrics used by downstream insight services.

solution_components.name: Azure data factory
solution_components.role: Ingests customer data into the centralized Snowflake environment.

solution_components.name: Airflow
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates the recurring HR data pipelines and insight workflows.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Presents embedded dashboards for customers that want ready-made workforce and cost insights.

solution_components.name: private Snowflake Marketplace
solution_components.role: Shares data products directly with customers that want deeper self-service analysis in their own Snowflake environments.

data_flow: Payroll, HCM, finance, and business data is ingested with DBT, Azure data factory, and Airflow into Snowflake on Azure, where it is standardized and enriched with weekly benchmarking datasets. The resulting HR insights are served either through Power BI embedded dashboards in a web app or through direct Snowflake and Marketplace sharing for customers that want deeper self-service analysis.
business_outcome: SD Worx gives 7,000 customers actionable workforce insight across 650,000 employees, replaces fragmented HR tools with one governed view of truth, supports compliance and cost control, and creates a consulting-led revenue stream on top of the shared data foundation.
